title: Progress on the soft anomalous dimension in QCD
summary: We review the state-of-the-art knowledge of IR singularities in multileg QCD amplitudes, identifying the key reasons for the remarkable simplicity of the soft anomalous dimension. We then present a novel strategy to compute this quantity using a lightcone expansion of correlators of semi-infinite Wilson lines by the Method of Regions. Recently, this strategy allowed us to determine the three-loop soft anomalous dimension for amplitudes consisting of a single massive coloured particle with any number of massless ones.
